plan_review.notes: Initial 3x3 nearest-tile design rejected. Revised to explicit true-player metadata plus physically-overlapped cardinal candidates; final revision evaluates every valid candidate and takes minimum finite strict A* cost. Rejected generic A* permissiveness, player snapping, exception fallback, deferred replanning, and generic virtual multi-source A*. Final re-review passed with no concerns.

independent_grade.notes: The diff adds an opt-in blockedStartRecovery contract to the strict Floor 1 travel oracle: when the configured player-start location's center maps to an impassable tile, it evaluates only cardinal neighbor tiles whose rectangles physically intersect the player body (AABB closest-point vs radius-squared, with EPSILON on the boundary), runs the unchanged strict A* from each, and takes the minimum finite cost. Recovery is correctly scoped to from === recovery.locationId and gated on !passable(startTile), so all other legs, blocked goals, diagonal-only openings, locked doors, unconfigured starts, and zero/negative radius remain strict Infinity failures. Five focused unit tests plus the exact fireball-25 real-headless regression cover the change. Determinism is preserved, the memoization key incorporates the effects set that drives passability, the bt-ai-provider wiring passes canonical Size.radius, and no layer boundary or runtime system wiring contract is violated.
